name: GPT-6.1 Sol (Fast)
description: GPT-6.1 Sol is OpenAI's reasoning model for complex coding, computer use, and professional work. It accepts text and images, generates text, and supports a 1,050,000-token context window with up to 128,000 output tokens. Configurable reasoning effort, structured outputs, prompt caching, and Responses API tools support multi-step workflows.
